expired.description: Current TTL or withdrawal state; keyed retry never revives an expired record.

id.description: Opaque fact id. On status=duplicate this is the EXISTING fact's id.

status.description: Branch on THIS, never on status_text.

status_text.description: Human rendering of status. Display only -- never branch on it.

degraded_dedup.description: Present (true) when no embedding provider -- near-duplicates may insert.
